annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/437 of 24 March 2020 on the harmonised standards for medical devices drafted in support of Council Directive 93/42/EEC
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/437 of 24 March 2020 on the harmonised standards for medical devices drafted in support of Council Directive 93/42/EEC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision publishing references of harmonised standards for medical devices under Directive 93/42/EEC, giving presumption of conformity. It lists standards in annexes, withdraws superseded ones, repeals a 2017 communication, and applies until 26 May 2024. It is not usable for conformity with Regulation 2017/745.
key_provisions_or_claims: Publishes references of harmonised standards listed in Annex I in the Official Journal
Repeals Communication 2017/C 389/03; it continues to apply to Annex II standards until 30 September 2021
Standards may not confer presumption of conformity with Regulation (EU) 2017/745
Updates standards such as EN ISO 10993-11:2018, EN 14683:2019, EN ISO 15747:2019
